source.source: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board DTM 1 m

attribution: Elevation data: Republic of Estonia Land and Spatial Development Board, extracted 2026-10-09.
limitations: Bilinear samples of official 1 m DTM stored on a 2.5 m grid. Automated classification can retain elevated terraces or incorrectly classify built surfaces; this is ground-contact evidence, not a survey of doors, stairs or buried foundations. Model Y0=7.2 m EH2000 is the rounded exterior ground attachment near the cathedral, not the architect interior +0.00=8.30 m.
